title: Communist Literature Obtained In The Western District

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY. File No. Section 2D 2554/35 Special Branch. Date 29/9/33）
Subject (in full) Communist literature obtained in the Western District.
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa Forwarded by
I forward herewith four copies of communist booklets
and handbills which were obtained by Agents A1287 in Western
Chapei on September 24, 1933. A summarized translation
of the contents of the documents is given hereunder:-
(1) Booklet entitled "Vanguard, issue No. 19", dated 11.9.33,
purporting to emanate from the Kiangsu Provincial Committee
of the Chinese Communist Youth League. It contains
articles bearing on the September 18th Anniversary (the
outbreak of the Sino-Japanese conflict in Manchuria), the
arrival of the delegates of the Anti-War Congress, and news
relating to labour matters.
(2) Booklet entitled "The Construction of the League," dated
10.9.33, purporting to emanate from the Organization Depart-
ment of the Central Headquarters of the Chinese Communist
Youth League. It contains among other matters an article
urging comrades to check the movements of members who are
suspected of being traitors and to inspect careful
daily work of members of the executive staff.
(3) Handbill (origin not mentioned) containing the following
slogans:-
(a) Oppose dismissal of workers!
(b) Increase in pay!
(c) Oppose the abuse of workers!
(d) Oppose any decrease of pay and extra work!
(e) Overthrow running dogs!
(4) Handbill entitled "Letter to poor and labouring young masses
throughout the country in connection with the proposed
partition of China by imperialists and the 5th Anti-Communist
Campaign of the Kuomintang," dated 10.9.33, purporting to

上海公共租界工部局警务处
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别股登记处。档案号 第2D科 2554/35 特别股。日期 1933年9月29日）
事由（全称）：在西区缴获的共产主义宣传品。
呈报人：侦探督察 顾宝华（Kuh Pao Hwa，音译） 转呈人
兹随函附上四份共产主义小册子及传单，系特工 A1287 于1933年9月24日在闸北西部缴获。现将文件内容摘要翻译如下：
(1) 小册子，题为《先锋》，第19期，日期为1933年9月11日，声称出自中国共产主义青年团江苏省委员会。其中包含有关“九一八”纪念日（即满洲中日冲突爆发）、反战大会代表抵达以及劳工相关新闻的文章。
(2) 小册子，题为《团的建立》，日期为1933年9月10日，声称出自中国共产主义青年团中央总部组织部。除其他事项外，其中包含一篇文章，敦促同志们审查被怀疑为叛徒的成员的动向，并仔细检查执行机构成员的日常工作情况。
(3) 传单（未注明出处），包含以下标语：
(a) 反对开除工人！
(b) 增加工资！
(c) 反对虐待工人！
(d) 反对任何减薪和加班！
(e) 打倒走狗！
(4) 传单，题为《致全国贫苦劳动青年书——关于帝国主义瓜分中国及国民党第五次“围剿”》，日期为1933年9月10日，声称出自
